context: Tests whether the agent checks for existing commit conventions before applying defaults, uses the BREAKING CHANGE footer notation for a breaking API removal, writes a meaningful body explaining the impact, uses an appropriate commit type, and avoids WIP markers. The inputs directory includes a .commitlintrc to verify the agent checks for it.

checklist.name: Detects .commitlintrc
checklist.description: commit-message.txt or commit-log.txt shows a commit format consistent with the .commitlintrc config in inputs/ (uses Conventional Commits format, since the config enforces it), OR commit-log.txt documents that .commitlintrc was found and followed

checklist.name: BREAKING CHANGE footer present
checklist.description: commit-message.txt contains 'BREAKING CHANGE:' in the footer section (after a blank line separating it from the body)

checklist.name: BREAKING CHANGE is meaningful
checklist.description: The text after 'BREAKING CHANGE:' describes what changed and what clients must do — not just a placeholder or the word 'yes'

checklist.name: Appropriate commit type
checklist.description: The commit header uses 'feat', 'refactor', or 'fix' as the type — NOT 'chore' or 'docs' (removal of an endpoint is a functional change)

checklist.name: Commit body present
checklist.description: commit-message.txt contains a body (text between header and footer) explaining the removal of v1/charge and the migration path to v2/payment

checklist.name: Blank line before body
checklist.description: There is a blank line separating the commit header from the body in commit-message.txt

checklist.name: Blank line before footer
checklist.description: There is a blank line separating the body from the BREAKING CHANGE footer in commit-message.txt

checklist.name: Imperative mood
checklist.description: The commit header description uses imperative mood (e.g. 'remove', 'drop', 'delete') not past tense (e.g. 'removed', 'deleted')

checklist.name: Lowercase header start
checklist.description: The description part of the commit header starts with a lowercase letter

checklist.name: Header <= 72 chars
checklist.description: The commit header line is at most 72 characters long

checklist.name: No WIP markers
checklist.description: commit-message.txt does NOT contain 'WIP', 'wip', 'temp', 'Temp', 'TODO', or other placeholder markers

checklist.name: commit-log.txt produced
checklist.description: commit-log.txt exists and contains the output of git log -1 showing a single commit
